milestone: P3 — element-side non-local (regularised) damage for DKT18
headline: The DKT18 numbers are UNCHANGED, and that is the expected outcome rather than a measurement needing explanation: both routines this task ports are reached only under INLOC = IPARG(78) > 0 (cdkforc3.F:498 and :573), and no parity case sets /NONLOCAL, so the INLOC == 0 cycle is bit-identical by construction.

re_measurement.what: A full before/after A/B of the bundled DKT18 example (examples/rd_e_1000_dkt18, /RUN/ROLLING/1) under the pinned interpreter, because a rel-RMS to four decimals cannot show 'unchanged' the way an identity can.
re_measurement.engine_termination: ERROR — NUMERICAL ENERGY INJECTION -30.1% EXCEEDS LIMIT 30.0% — RUN UNSTABLE (the port's pre-existing DKT18 deviation; the Fortran side runs this same deck to completion)
re_measurement.before: main (this branch's parent), same interpreter and oracle
re_measurement.result: IDENTICAL.  diff of the two engine .out files over all 11539 lines returns only the two RESTART path lines and the elapsed-time line; every numeric line, every per-cycle time-history row and the termination summary match exactly.
re_measurement.why_this_is_the_right_evidence: cdkfint_reg.F and dtcdk_reg.F are unreachable at INLOC == 0, so the only honest claim is that nothing moved — and this measures it directly rather than inferring it from an unchanged rounded rel-RMS.

harness_run.fortran_status: the Fortran Starter+Engine ran this deck to completion in 51.65 s (1243215 cycles) and wrote its T01, but no th_to_csv converter is installed in this oracle prefix, so the harness could not build the Fortran-side channel set
harness_run.note: The class is the port's pre-existing DKT18 result and is unchanged by this task; see the re_measurement block for the before/after identity that establishes it.

conclusion: No parity number moved, none was tuned, and none needed explaining. This task closed a porting-coverage gap (two genuinely unported routines behind the INLOC>0 guard), not a measured-parity gap.
